name.title: Connection name
name.description: A label you choose for this connection — not a hostname. Heimdall's URL is fixed and never configured here.

authMode.title: Auth mode
authMode.description: Only mode supported: reads the Gatekeeper cookie file automatically (~/.pattern/gatekeeper/heimdall.json or /etc/gatekeeper/heimdall.json) — nothing to type in. Hidden from the form, see ui.schema.json.
